results.name: valid submission stores encrypted optional contact and versioned consent
lost-response retry returns original receipt before reusing Turnstile
pending retry across UTC midnight is stable
changed payload conflicts with the same receipt
unknown fields and required consent fail without storing data
impossible/future dates and completed/pending mismatch are rejected
left-unexamined is a distinct valid concluded outcome
large and malformed JSON fail without echoing body
disallowed origin and unauthenticated export are rejected
wrong Turnstile success/hostname/action cannot store a response
database failure cannot return accepted success
wrong deletion token is rejected, correct token removes response and contact
scheduled expiry prunes old responses, contacts and rate buckets

limits: Independent synthetic endpoint checks use an in-memory D1 stand-in and a controlled Siteverify response, not real users or a deployed endpoint.

They do not establish production secret configuration, Cloudflare D1 transaction behavior, cron execution, browser storage/privacy copy, email follow-up tooling, provider logging/backup retention, or one-response-per-person validity.
D1 atomic batches and Turnstile single-use behavior were separately checked against official provider documentation.
